payload.claim: The spec leaves the turn prompt saffron/agents/prompts/turns/criterion-probe.md's trigger text 'Name the edit now' (singular) unchanged even though the session is now asked to enumerate every sentence of the claim, unlike its wrong-version analog turns/wrong-version.md, which reads 'Name each edit now' (plural) for the same kind of multi-item ask. This is explicitly called out and accepted by the spec author in the Out of scope section ('still serves a session asked for a list'), so it is an already-made decision rather than an open one, but it is a slight precedent mismatch worth the operator's awareness since it could affect probe quality in practice.
